annotations.title: Choose who posts approved vendor Slack replies: the Summer Ellis app, a Summer Teammate (AI employee) from its own Slack account, or the person who approves each reply, from their own connected Slack account

description: Choose who posts approved vendor Slack replies: the Summer Ellis app, a Summer Teammate (AI employee) from its own Slack account, or the person who approves each reply, from their own connected Slack account. Uses the revision from slack.identity.read and a reason. Sends no message.

idempotency_key.description: Reuse the same key when retrying the same change

revision.description: Current revision from slack.identity.read; 0 before the first save.

sender.description: Who posts. Leave out to choose from teammate_id alone. 'approver' posts as whoever approves each reply; that person needs their own Slack account connected (slack.account.read).

teammate_id.description: An active teammate from teammates.list when sender is 'teammate', otherwise null.
